name: Browser Use
description: Give Claude a real browser — your Chrome or a Browser Use Cloud browser. Use it whenever a task involves a website or web app: browsing, scraping and data extraction, filling forms, testing sites, taking screenshots, automating web workflows.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `browser-use`.

Installs with `claude plugin install browser-use@claude-plugins-official` from `browser-use/plugins` (`browser-use`).

Give Claude Code a real browser — your Chrome or a Browser Use Cloud browser — powered by the Browser Use CLI 3.0.
